name: Worthy
overview: The Bible teaches that worthiness is ultimately measured by our relationship with Christ and our love for Him above all else, as those who prioritize family over Him are deemed unworthy (Matthew 10:37). Our value before God is rooted not in our works but in His marvelous creation of us and His providential care, demonstrated by His feeding of the birds and His knowledge of us as wonderfully made (Psalms 139:14; Matthew 6:26). True worthiness comes through faith in Christ, who gave Himself for us, enabling us to live by His life and receive everlasting life (John 3:16; Galatians 2:20). Even those invited to God's kingdom must respond in faith, for some are found not worthy to enter (Matthew 22:8).
